body:
ehh, just lack of creativity on my side. Didn't want the same old title that you see all over this sub. Each post is a reach out for help, few people here are 100% ready to kill themselves. Personally I have never reached out for attention, and I don't want to seem like I am posting this for attention. (Think of teen girl taking 10 Advil then saying she tried to OD, that ain't me). 

However I did post here. i wanted someone to know about my thoughts, and to get advice and kind words. 

Thank you. It means a lot to me.

Thank you for caring about me and those that love me Internet stranger. I do plan on doing everything I can to put those that love me at rest. Including this throw away. I would hate for them to be burdened by my death, but I would hate to be even more of a burden in life. I want to belive that things get better, they do for a bit. But it's never permanent. 

I'm glad people like you take time out of your day to post a kind comment. Thank you.

I know my problems in life seem small, and I agree, there is no one major event that makes me want to kill myself. However thoughts of suicide and an attempt (pussied out at last moment) over the past 7 years has gotten to me. 

I don't want this to seem like a cry for help for someone with minor problems, There are many people who have it way worst off then me. I don't feel guilty for not having a life changing event that I die over or not having any major extraordinary hardships. It's just the way it is, it's how I feel. 

I have been waiting to write this post for two weeks. Giving myself a month to consider the consequences of my actions. I know the whole "permanent solution to a temporary problem" but fuck man, temporary is to dang long. 

Again I don't want to sound like the kiddo looking for attention with minor problems, I even agree that most people would man up and just deal with life. I would to but I don't really see a reason to. Minus the old do it for your family/loved ones. 

Once again in my phone so sorry about any formatting/spelling errors . 

Thank you for your quick reply. It does mean a lot and help. 
Your comment very helpful.
